title: Telephone Conversation Audio Segmentation
description: Annotated a telephone conversation using Unitlab to create structured audio data for AI and speech-processing applications.
objective: Create accurately segmented and speaker-labeled audio data that can support speech-processing and AI model development.
steps: Reviewed the telephone conversation and annotation requirements.
Segmented the recording into individual speaker turns.
Identified and labeled speakers throughout the conversation.
Added accurate timestamps to each audio segment.
Reviewed the completed annotations for consistency and quality.
results: Produced structured speaker-level audio segments with timestamps and consistent labels, followed by a quality review of the completed annotations.

challenges.problem: Accurately identifying speaker changes and segment boundaries can be difficult in natural conversations.
challenges.solution: Listened carefully to transitions and reviewed segment boundaries to maintain accurate speaker turns and timestamps.
